he.text: זוהי הוא מתחם מגורים חדש בשכונת אשכול ברובע שדה דב, על מגרש 110 ברחוב ש"י עגנון. הפרויקט משלב 230 דירות בנות 2-6 חדרים ופנטהאוזים, גן עירוני פנימי, בריכת דיירים, לאונג', חדר כושר וסטודיו יוגה. התכנון האדריכלי של גל אור פישביין מתייחס לשפת העיר הלבנה ולבנייה מרקמית עם מגדלונים נמוכים יחסית לרובע. היזמים הם מבנה, לוינשטין ומטרופוליס.

en.text: ZOHI is a new residential compound in Eshkol, Sde Dov, on lot 110 at Shai Agnon Street. It combines 230 apartments, 2-6 room homes and penthouses, an internal urban garden, resident pool, lounge, gym and yoga studio. Gal Or Fishbein Architects frame the project around Tel Aviv white-city references and a low-rise plus towerlet urban fabric. The development partners are Mivne, Levinstein and Metropolis.

fr.text: ZOHI est un nouveau complexe residentiel a Sde Dov, dans le quartier Eshkol, sur le lot 110. Le projet propose 230 appartements, des logements de 2 a 6 pieces et des penthouses, avec jardin urbain, piscine, lounge, salle de sport et studio de yoga. Le langage architectural s'appuie sur l'identite de la ville blanche de Tel Aviv. Les partenaires sont Mivne, Levinstein et Metropolis.

ru.text: ZOHI - новый жилой комплекс в районе Eshkol в Sde Dov, на участке 110 у улицы Shai Agnon. В проекте 230 квартир, планировки 2-6 комнат и пентхаусы, внутренний городской сад, бассейн для жильцов, лаунж, спортзал и студия йоги. Архитектурная концепция связана с белым городом Тель Авива. Девелоперы проекта - Mivne, Levinstein и Metropolis.

ar.text: زوهי هو مجمع سكني جديد في حي إشكول ضمن منطقة سديه دوف، على القسيمة 110 قرب شارع شاي عجنون. يضم المشروع 230 شقة، شققا من 2-6 غرف وبنتهاوس، مع حديقة حضرية داخلية ومسبح للسكان ولاونج وناد رياضي واستوديو يوغا. تستند الرؤية المعمارية إلى روح تل أبيب والمدينة البيضاء. الشركاء المطورون هم Mivne و Levinstein و Metropolis.

neighborhood_narrative.he: שכונת אשכול היא השלב הראשון והבשל יותר של רובע שדה דב: רובע חדש בצפון תל אביב, בין הים, הירקון, צירי תחבורה עתידיים ומוקדי תרבות ותעסוקה. זוהי מתאים לקונים שמחפשים דירה חדשה בצפון הישן החדש של העיר, עם קרבה לים ולנמל, אך בתוך רובע מתוכנן עם מסחר רחובי, פארקים, שבילי אופניים ותחבורה ציבורית עתידית.
neighborhood_narrative.en: Eshkol is the early, central neighborhood of the Sde Dov district, positioned between the sea, Yarkon Park, new transit corridors and future mixed-use development. ZOHI suits buyers who want a new Tel Aviv home close to the coast and port, but within a planned district with street commerce, open spaces, bike infrastructure and future mass transit.
neighborhood_narrative.fr: Eshkol est le premier noyau urbain du nouveau quartier de Sde Dov. ZOHI vise des acheteurs qui recherchent une adresse neuve au nord de Tel Aviv, proche de la mer, du port et des futurs transports, avec commerces de rue, espaces verts et services de quartier.
neighborhood_narrative.ru: Eshkol - один из первых формируемых кварталов Sde Dov. ZOHI подойдет покупателям, которым нужна новая квартира в северной части Тель Авива рядом с морем, портом, будущим транспортом, уличной торговлей, зелеными зонами и велосипедной сетью.
neighborhood_narrative.ar: إشكول هو أحد الأحياء الأولى في منطقة سديه دوف الجديدة. يناسب ZOHI المشترين الذين يريدون سكنا جديدا في شمال تل أبيب قرب البحر والميناء، مع تخطيط حضري حديث يشمل تجارة على مستوى الشارع ومساحات خضراء ومسارات دراجات ومواصلات مستقبلية.

faq_seeds.question: What is the exact building address of ZOHI?
faq_seeds.answer_seed: Use Shai Agnon 11, Tel Aviv Yafo for the project address, with parcel context lot 110, Unit 8, Eshkol, Sde Dov. Keep sales office separate because no exact sales office address was verified.

faq_seeds.question: How many apartments are in ZOHI?
What apartment sizes are planned?
faq_seeds.answer_seed: Official marketing says 2-6 room apartments and penthouses. The design plan gives statutory size categories: 58 small, 57 medium and 115 large apartments.

faq_seeds.question: How many buildings and floors are planned?
faq_seeds.answer_seed: The municipal design plan describes two 16-floor towerlets and two 9-floor low-rise buildings. Marketing and media sometimes summarize this differently, so this is a known conflict.

faq_seeds.question: Does the project include a pool?
faq_seeds.answer_seed: Yes. The official site lists a swimming pool and the design plan places a resident pool and toddler pool on the low-rise roof.

faq_seeds.question: How close is ZOHI to the light rail?
faq_seeds.answer_seed: The official site says 7 minutes walking to the future Green Line station, but it does not publish a verified exact station name.

faq_seeds.question: Is ZOHI on the beachfront?
faq_seeds.answer_seed: No verified source describes it as beachfront. The official page says it is within walking distance of the sea, port and promenade.

faq_seeds.question: When is occupancy expected?
faq_seeds.answer_seed: Media sources report expected occupancy in the second half of 2030, but the official website did not expose a delivery date in the reviewed text.

faq_seeds.question: Are prices published?
faq_seeds.answer_seed: No official developer price list was found. Madlan shows an average project price per sqm and several transaction rows at the address; media reports mention about 70,000 ILS per sqm at launch.

faq_seeds.question: Will adjacent buildings block views?
faq_seeds.answer_seed: North lot 109 is planned with a tower up to 40 floors, so north-facing views may be affected. Exact line-by-line impact requires a measured model.

faq_seeds.question: Who is the architect?
faq_seeds.answer_seed: Gal Or Fishbein Architects is named in municipal and official sources; Tal Goldsmith is quoted on interior design language on the official site.

faq_seeds.question: Does the project include parking and storage?
faq_seeds.answer_seed: The design plan indicates 5 basement floors, storage rooms, a maximum 1:1 residential parking ratio, bike parking and EV charging preparation.

coverage.biggest_gaps_summary: The strongest verified facts are the address, parcel context, total units, statutory massing, heights, amenities, unit-size mix, parking policy and district planning. The biggest gaps for production are exact sales-office address, measured distances in meters, official station name, floor-plan URLs, unit-line orientation, dimensioned footprints, facade elevations by orientation, current inventory, official price list and contractor identity. Several public sources conflict on whether the project should be represented as 3 marketing buildings or 4 physical design-plan buildings, and on 15 versus 16 floors for the towerlets.
